description: Menial refactor: one local subagent, basic or standard tier, refactor tag (G2, G15).
prompt: In my repo at ~/code/inventory, rename the function load_items to read_inventory everywhere under src/, and keep the tests passing (pytest from the repo root).

replies.report: Renamed load_items to read_inventory in 6 files under src/ and in 2 test files. pytest from the repo root: 48 passed.

arguments.brief:
## Goal
Rename the function load_items to read_inventory everywhere under src/ in ~/code/inventory, keeping behaviour unchanged.

## Context
Repository: ~/code/inventory (Python). Tests run with pytest from the repo root.

## Constraints
Change only the name, its call sites and imports; no other edits.

## Acceptance
- No occurrence of load_items remains under src/ or tests/.
- pytest from the repo root passes.

## Output format
The changed files and the pytest summary line.

reference.content: Done: load_items is now read_inventory in 6 source files and 2 test files, and pytest reports 48 passed.
